export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for slug 'nick-petrochem-private-limited' shows 'Total Shipments 753 Records detected', 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-23', with rows such as: '2026-02-23 | NICK PETROCHEM PRIVATE LIMITED | GLOBAL TOP LINK TECHNOLOGIES CO., L | LUBRICATING OIL AEROSHELL OIL 100- | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | Yangon, Myanmar | 27101972 | 9940493' and '2026-01-06 | NICK PETROCHEM PRIVATE LIMITED | TO ORDER | LUBRICATING OIL- | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | Port Louis, MAURITIUS | 27101972 | 8521254'. Source counter: page claims 753 total shipments; rows actually visible on the free view = 5 (dates 2025-12-26, 2026-01-06, 2026-01-29, 2026-02-17, 2026-02-23). Destinations seen: Myanmar (Yangon), Nepal (Bhairawa, via Sonauli LCS), Mauritius (Port Louis), Guinea (Conakry). HS codes seen: 27101972, 27101990, 38200000 — consistent with declared 271019 (lubricating oils).
note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with HS codes and destinations, not by company claims — the company is an active exporter of lubricating oils/greases/coolants out of Nhava Sheva Sea and Sonauli LCS. Note the trade direction on the ImportKey page is ambiguous (the same page also lists 'Suppliers' and 'Buyers' blocks where the company appears as a counterparty), so the rows above are read as the company's own export filings; the 753 figure is the site's counter and only 5 rows were actually visible, so the full record set was not independently counted. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could NOT be checked: the web_search backend returned connection errors on every attempt and the registry/aggregator sites (thecompanycheck, volza, eximpedia, trademo) returned HTTP 403. Domestic status is therefore 'unknown', not 'none_found' — absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not a finding. No revenue or export-volume figures are public on the free views, so those fields are null rather than estimated. HS 271019 is consistent with the observed cargo, so no HS correction is needed.
